explanation: Total distance = 320 + 380 = 700 m. Relative speed in opposite direction = 116 + 134 = 250 km/h = 250 * (5/18) = 69.44 m/s. Time = 700 / 69.44 = 10.1 seconds.

explanation: Using combination formula C(n, r) = n! / (r! * (n-r)!) = (7 * 6) / 2 = 21 ways.
